entries.state_summary: The retrospective RH-SPEC-002 calibration leaves a source-side residual: generic spectral topology has been pruned, but the actual CCM route still lacks a theorem connecting the true lowest Weil-form eigenfunction to the prolate proxy whose transform is known to approach Xi.

evidence_pointers: Alain Connes, Caterina Consani, Henri Moscovici, arXiv:2511.22755v1, Sections 7-8
uncertainties: whether QW_lambda has a quantitatively isolated even ground state uniformly enough for the outer limit
residuals: fresh context/memory/review/trace required before any source-side theorem candidate

entries.state_summary: The atom is represented as a conditioning/stability bridge rather than a vague determinant limit: small proxy error can identify the true ground state only with explicit spectral separation and normalization, followed by weighted analytic-transform control.
entries.action_summary: Freeze the RH-SPEC-002a MathContextFiber and source packet before candidate generation.

entries.state_summary: Cross-domain scan retained a conditioning analogy from modal identification/inverse problems: a small residual does not determine a latent mode under near-degeneracy; the stability denominator is load-bearing.
entries.action_summary: Retain only the residual-versus-conditioning abstraction and reject surface analogies that do not expose a QW_lambda validation obligation.
evidence_pointers: Tosio Kato, Perturbation Theory for Linear Operators
uncertainties: engineering conditioning is not itself RH mathematics
residuals: need a target-domain two-mode hostile control

entries.state_summary: Four transfer families are now separated: isolated-eigenvalue residual/gap stability, fixed-lambda Rayleigh-Ritz convergence, weighted transform convergence, and conditioning-based hostile calibration.
entries.action_summary: Record each method's assumptions, disanalogies, and smallest repair question; do not transfer de Branges or random-matrix conclusions without source objects satisfying their hypotheses.
evidence_pointers: Alain Connes, Caterina Consani, Henri Moscovici, arXiv:2511.22755v1
Tosio Kato, Perturbation Theory for Linear Operators

entries.state_summary: A six-role same-context cell reviewed arithmetic source fidelity, self-adjoint perturbation, prolate/Weil comparison, adversarial near-degeneracy, formal assurance, and novelty/research value.
entries.action_summary: Reject immediate determinant-convergence or eigenvector-closeness claims. Select a pre-candidate discriminator that first asks whether the prolate proxy admits a source-defined residual-over-ground-gap certificate and whether the finite-N/outer-lambda limits can be separated cleanly.
alternatives_considered: assert k_lambda is close because the numerical profiles agree
use the tiny lowest eigenvalue as a proxy for spectral separation
jump directly to a de Branges positivity candidate
freeze a gap-normalized residual calibration before theorem invention
entries.decision_rationale: The residual-over-gap discriminator has high partition power: if the gap collapses too fast, a whole class of proxy-identification arguments fails; if a uniform or rate-controlled separation survives, standard isolated-eigenspace tools become legitimately applicable without yet asserting RH.
uncertainties: actual QW_lambda gap behavior is unknown

entries.state_summary: RH-specific post-calibration memory now contains a conditionally reusable Hurwitz target-side tool and explicit failures for strong-resolvent incompleteness, Galerkin pollution, joint-limit ambiguity, finite-zero-prefix overreach, and chronology failure.
entries.action_summary: Freeze a memory review bound to exact Git blob identities of the current RH tool and failure snapshots. Select Hurwitz only as the downstream endpoint; use the failures as warnings and regressions, not impossibility claims.
alternatives_considered: ignore retrospective memory because it has no root authority
treat Hurwitz as if it supplied source convergence
use the memory only to define source-side applicability obligations and hostile regressions
entries.decision_rationale: The existing memory sharply separates target-side zero transport from the missing source-side convergence. This prevents repeating finite-zero and generic-operator-topology dead ends while preserving the prolate/ground-state route as an open target-specific question.
uncertainties: failure records are SUPPORTED warnings, not verified impossibilities

entries.state_summary: RH-SPEC-002a now has frozen source context, structural analogy, method-transfer matrix, same-context expert review, and dual memory review. Candidate generation may be considered only after machine audit of this packet.
entries.action_summary: After the strict packet passes, build a candidate-independent GAP-RESIDUAL CALIBRATION contract before any RH theorem candidate: (i) define the relevant even-sector ground gap g_lambda and a source-computable proxy residual/Rayleigh excess r_lambda; (ii) plant a nearly-degenerate two-mode negative control where r_lambda->0 but r_lambda/g_lambda does not; (iii) freeze fixed-lambda N->infinity and outer lambda->infinity order; (iv) only then ask whether the actual QW_lambda/prolate data support r_lambda/g_lambda->0 in a weighted norm sufficient for compact-uniform transform convergence.
alternatives_considered: prove simplicity/evenness immediately without a discriminator
fit a scalar normalization using known zeta zeros
use numerical eigenvalue accuracy as a convergence surrogate
first calibrate the stability denominator and source-space-to-transform bridge
entries.decision_rationale: This action maximizes epistemic contraction without inventing a theorem prematurely: it can falsify the proxy-identification mechanism at the level of conditioning, or expose the exact quantitative inequalities that a subsequent candidate must prove.
uncertainties: the exact operator-domain residual and best gap coordinate remain to be defined after audit
next_steps: if PASS, freeze the exact calibration evaluator before evaluating source quantities
